source_notes.market_archive: Alghaf Marine public APAG archive indications; non-binding market information, not a licensed assessment or commercial offer. Source archives are as-available observations rather than a guaranteed daily feed; the website shows the source observation date and provides a direct verification link.
source_notes.fx_model_history: Bangladesh Bank-attributed historical Buy/Sell midpoint via Fexant for consistent daily history; direct Bangladesh Bank reference-rate page is retained as the current official reference source.
source_notes.official_prices: Version-controlled public reporting of Bangladesh government fuel-price decisions; each row carries its source URL and source tier. The website separately shows the official price known at a model cutoff and the latest overall official event when it occurs later.
source_notes.policy_window: 30 calendar days is a transparent proxy for the prior-period/moving-average concept in the published automatic-pricing framework, not a claim to reproduce BPC's private accounting or proprietary data feed.
